"""
module: lru_ttl_cache

A thread-safe LRU (Least Recently Used) cache with automatic Time-To-Live (TTL)
expiration.

Features:
- Thread-safe operations via a reentrant (RLock) lock.
- O(1) get, set, and eviction using an OrderedDict.
- Automatic expiry of entries after a configurable TTL (in seconds).
- Cleanup of expired entries during get/set/evict operations.
- Optional background "heartbeat" thread that periodically purges expired
  entries without blocking the main application thread.

Design notes:
- The core cache stores entries as tuples `(value, expiry_ts)`.
- `expiry_ts` is a Unix timestamp (float) computed as `time.time() + ttl`.
- When an entry is accessed it is moved to the most-recently-used (MRU) end.
- When the cache reaches its capacity, the least-recently-used entry is evicted.
- The lock is held only for the duration of the dict mutation, keeping
  contention low while guaranteeing thread safety.
